name: Observability Data Export to Amazon S3
overview: Export LaunchDarkly Observability data to an Amazon S3 bucket that you own.
description: Send sessions, session events, error groups, logs, and traces from LaunchDarkly Observability to your own Amazon S3 bucket. LaunchDarkly writes new data about every 15 minutes as Parquet, CSV, or newline-delimited JSON files, in folders by data type and date.
author: LaunchDarkly

formVariables.name: Project and environment
formVariables.description: Select the LaunchDarkly project and environment whose Observability data you want to export. You cannot edit this after you save the configuration.

formVariables.name: Data to export
formVariables.description: Select the Observability data to export. LaunchDarkly writes each data type to its own folder.

formVariables.name: Bucket name
formVariables.description: The name of the S3 bucket that LaunchDarkly writes to.

formVariables.name: Bucket region
formVariables.description: The AWS region of the bucket.

formVariables.name: Folder
formVariables.description: The prefix of the files in the bucket. LaunchDarkly writes files to `<folder>/<data type>/date=<YYYY-MM-DD>/`.

formVariables.name: IAM role ARN
formVariables.description: The IAM role that LaunchDarkly assumes to write to the bucket. The role must allow `s3:PutObject` on the bucket, and its trust policy must require the external ID `ld-<your LaunchDarkly account ID>`.

formVariables.name: File format
formVariables.description: The format of the exported files. Parquet files are compressed with zstd. CSV and JSON files are compressed with gzip.

formVariables.name: CSV delimiter
formVariables.description: One character that separates fields in CSV files. Leave empty to use a comma.
